<header class="site-header">
<style>
/* =========================================================================
   NIFTY WEBSITES AUSTRALIA - TOP HEADER NAVIGATION
   Pure CSS. Nothing the visitor can see or open depends on JavaScript, so
   the header keeps working even where an importer strips out scripting.
   ========================================================================= */

:root{
  --amber:#f7a80a; --amber-l:#ffc247; --amber-d:#c47a08;
  --blue:#3b82f6;
  --bg2:#0b0d16;
  --ink:#f4f6fb; --ink2:#c9cfdd; --mut:#8b93a8;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --line2:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.045); --glass2:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --hdrbg:rgba(8,10,18,.82); --hdrtext:#dbe2f5; --menubg:#0b0e1a;
  --utilbg:rgba(5,6,15,.86); --utiltext:#9aa3c0;
  --ring:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --ring-strong:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --e1:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.45),var(--ring);
  --e4:0 40px 90px -34px rgba(0,0,0,.85),var(--ring-strong);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.36,1); --t-fast:.18s;
  --fdisp:'Sora',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --fbody:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --r:18px; --r-pill:999px;
  --gut:clamp(18px,5vw,44px); --maxw:1240px;
  --utilh:40px;
}
.site-header{--logo:url('data:image/png;base64,')}
@media(max-width:620px){:root{--utilh:36px}}

.site-header *,.site-header *::before,.site-header *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.site-header a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.site-header ul,.site-header ol{margin:0 0 1em;padding-left:1.15em}
.site-header li{margin-bottom:.4em}
.site-header h4{font-family:var(--fdisp);line-height:1.08;margin:0;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;font-weight:800;font-size:17px}
.site-header :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--amber-l);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
.site-header .ico{width:1em;height:1em;flex:0 0 auto;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;vertical-align:-.125em}
.site-header [data-not-in-build]{cursor:not-allowed}
.site-header [data-not-in-build]::after{content:" \2197";opacity:.5;font-size:.85em}

/* The whole navigation is one sticky block. The negative offset is the
   height of the utility bar, so the bar scrolls away and the main bar pins
   to the top, which is how the original behaved. */
.site-header{
  position:sticky;top:calc((var(--utilh) + 1px) * -1);z-index:140;
  font-family:var(--fbody);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink);
}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gut);padding-right:var(--gut)}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--amber);color:#111;
  padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;z-index:200}
.skip:focus{left:12px;top:12px}
.logoimg{background:var(--logo) center/contain no-repeat;display:block}

/* buttons used in the mega panel footers and the drawer */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55em;font-family:var(--fdisp);
  font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;letter-spacing:-.01em;padding:14px 26px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;min-height:48px;
  text-align:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             background var(--t-fast) var(--ease),border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn svg{transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn-amber{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--amber-l),var(--amber));color:#231704;
  box-shadow:0 0 26px -4px rgba(247,168,10,.60),0 0 46px -12px rgba(247,168,10,.45)}
.btn-amber:hover{box-shadow:0 0 36px -2px rgba(247,168,10,.80),0 0 60px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.50)}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--glass);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line2);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--glass2);border-color:rgba(247,168,10,.55)}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 18px;font-size:14px;min-height:40px}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ utility bar */
.utilbar{background:var(--utilbg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--utiltext);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.utilbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:22px;
  height:var(--utilh);flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.utilbar a{padding:8px 0;transition:color .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.utilbar a:hover{color:var(--amber-l)}
.utilbar .tel{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
@media(max-width:900px){.utilbar .util-hide{display:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .utilbar .wrap{justify-content:center}
  .utilbar a:not(.tel){display:none}
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- main bar */
.hdr{background:var(--hdrbg);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hdr .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
  min-height:92px;position:relative}

.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;padding:10px 18px;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);box-shadow:var(--e1);
  transition:border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.brand:hover{border-color:rgba(247,168,10,.45);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.55),var(--ring)}
.brand .logoimg{height:60px;width:auto;aspect-ratio:372/114}
@media(max-width:1180px){.brand .logoimg{height:48px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.brand .logoimg{height:38px}.brand{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:13px}}

.navcap{flex:0 1 auto;padding:5px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  border:1.5px solid transparent;
  background:
    linear-gradient(#0c0f1c,#0c0f1c) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(120deg,var(--amber),var(--blue) 55%,var(--amber)) border-box;
  box-shadow:0 0 30px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.50),0 0 18px -12px rgba(59,130,246,.50)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.nav > li{list-style:none;margin:0;position:static}
.nav ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
@media(max-width:1400px){.navlink{padding:9px 9px;font-size:14px}}
@media(max-width:1300px){.navlink{padding:9px 7px;font-size:13.6px}.navcap{padding:4px}}
@media(max-width:1180px){.navcap{border-color:transparent;background:none;box-shadow:none;padding:0}}

.navlink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 11px;
  font-family:var(--fdisp);font-weight:600;font-size:14.4px;color:var(--hdrtext);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);transition:background .15s,color .15s;background:none;
  border:0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.navlink .chev{transition:transform .2s}

/* ===== THE DROPDOWN FIX ============================================
   The mega panels used to be opened by JavaScript, which importers remove,
   so on the imported site nothing happened. They now open on :hover for
   pointer users and :focus-within for keyboard and touch users.
   =================================================================== */
.mega{
  position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 10px);left:50%;
  width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 48px));
  background:var(--menubg);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);
  box-shadow:var(--e4),0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  padding:26px;z-index:130;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px);
  transition:opacity var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             visibility 0s linear var(--t-fast);
}
.nav > li:hover > .mega,
.nav > li:focus-within > .mega{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  transition:opacity var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             visibility 0s;
}
/* Invisible bridge across the gap between the trigger and the panel. Without
   it the pointer leaves the list item on the way down and the panel shuts
   under the cursor, which is what made the old menu feel broken. */
.mega::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:100%;height:46px}

.navlink:hover,
.nav > li:hover > .navlink,
.nav > li:focus-within > .navlink{background:var(--glass2);color:var(--ink)}
.nav > li:hover > .navlink .chev,
.nav > li:focus-within > .navlink .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}

.mega-wide{width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-mid{width:min(660px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-nar{width:min(600px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-nar > ul{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0 30px;align-content:start}
.mega-nar .mega-foot{justify-content:flex-end}
.mega-cols{display:grid;gap:26px 30px}
.mega-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.mega-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.mega-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.mega-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.mega h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber);
  margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:700}
.mega li{margin:0}
.mega a{display:block;padding:8px 10px;margin-left:-10px;border-radius:9px;
  font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink2);transition:background .14s,color .14s}
.mega a:hover{background:var(--glass2);color:var(--ink)}
.mega a .sub{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:1px}
.mega a.hub{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.mega .tagged::after{content:attr(data-tag);display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;
  font-family:var(--fdisp);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--amber);border:1px solid rgba(247,168,10,.45);border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  padding:1px 7px;vertical-align:1px}
.mega-foot{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);

  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut)}

.hdr-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:0 0 auto;

  font-family:var(--fdisp);font-weight:700;font-size:14.6px;padding:9px 9px 9px 20px;

  box-shadow:0 0 26px -6px rgba(247,168,10,.60);
  transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.hdr-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 36px -4px rgba(247,168,10,.80)}
.hdr-cta .arrb{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:#231704;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.hdr-cta .arrb svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--amber-l)}
.hdr-cta:hover .arrb{transform:rotate(45deg)}
@media(max-width:1300px){.hdr-cta{padding:8px 16px;font-size:13.6px}.hdr-cta .arrb{display:none}}
@media(max-width:1180px){.hdr-cta{display:none}}

/* ------------------------------------------------- mobile drawer (no JS) */
/* The toggle is a real checkbox so it stays keyboard operable: Tab to it,
   press Space. It is a sibling of .mnav inside <header>, which is what lets
   the ~ selector below reach the drawer. */
.navtog{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;
  margin:0;padding:0;border:0;pointer-events:none}
.burger{display:none;margin-left:auto;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  border-radius:11px;width:46px;height:46px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:19px}
.navtog:focus-visible ~ .hdr .burger{outline:3px solid var(--amber-l);outline-offset:2px}
.mnav{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:140;background:var(--bg2);
  overflow-y:auto;padding:0 0 40px}
.navtog:checked ~ .mnav{display:block}
.mnav-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px var(--gut);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--bg2);z-index:2}
.mnav-top .close{margin-left:auto;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  border-radius:11px;width:44px;height:44px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font-size:19px;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

.macc{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.macc-t{position:absolute;top:18px;left:8px;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;margin:0;
  pointer-events:none}
.macc-lbl{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--fdisp);font-weight:700;font-size:17px;
  padding:18px var(--gut);cursor:pointer;min-height:56px}
.macc-lbl .chev{transition:transform .2s;color:var(--amber)}
.macc-t:checked ~ .macc-lbl .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.macc-t:focus-visible ~ .macc-lbl{outline:3px solid var(--amber-l);outline-offset:-3px}
.macc-lnk{display:block;padding:18px var(--gut);font-family:var(--fdisp);
  font-weight:700;font-size:17px}
.macc-panel{display:none;padding:0 var(--gut) 18px}
.macc-t:checked ~ .macc-panel{display:block}
.macc-panel h4{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--amber);margin:16px 0 8px;font-weight:700}
.macc-panel ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.macc-panel a{display:block;padding:11px 0;color:var(--ink2);font-size:15.5px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:44px}
.macc-panel a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.mnav-cta{padding:22px var(--gut) 0;display:grid;gap:12px}

@media(max-width:1080px){
  .nav{display:none}
  .navcap{display:none}
  .burger{display:inline-flex}
}
/* Above the hamburger breakpoint the drawer and its toggle are out of play
   entirely, including the tab order. */
@media(min-width:1081px){
  .navtog{display:none}
  .navtog:checked ~ .mnav{display:none}
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .site-header *,.site-header *::before,.site-header *::after{
    transition-duration:.001ms!important;animation-duration:.001ms!important}
}

<header class="site-header">
<style>
/* =========================================================================
   NIFTY WEBSITES AUSTRALIA - TOP HEADER NAVIGATION
   Pure CSS. Nothing the visitor can see or open depends on JavaScript, so
   the header keeps working even where an importer strips out scripting.
   ========================================================================= */

:root{
  --amber:#f7a80a; --amber-l:#ffc247; --amber-d:#c47a08;
  --blue:#3b82f6;
  --bg2:#0b0d16;
  --ink:#f4f6fb; --ink2:#c9cfdd; --mut:#8b93a8;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --line2:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.045); --glass2:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --hdrbg:rgba(8,10,18,.82); --hdrtext:#dbe2f5; --menubg:#0b0e1a;
  --utilbg:rgba(5,6,15,.86); --utiltext:#9aa3c0;
  --ring:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --ring-strong:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --e1:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.45),var(--ring);
  --e4:0 40px 90px -34px rgba(0,0,0,.85),var(--ring-strong);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.36,1); --t-fast:.18s;
  --fdisp:'Sora',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --fbody:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --r:18px; --r-pill:999px;
  --gut:clamp(18px,5vw,44px); --maxw:1240px;
  --utilh:40px;
}
.site-header{--logo:url('data:image/png;base64,')}
@media(max-width:620px){:root{--utilh:36px}}

.site-header *,.site-header *::before,.site-header *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.site-header a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
/* Every list inside the header is a navigation list, so the body-copy list
   indent and bottom margin are reset outright. Leaving them in place gave
   ul.nav a ~19px left indent and a 16.5px bottom margin, which pushed the
   menu right and up inside its capsule. */
.site-header ul,.site-header ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.site-header li{margin-bottom:.4em}
.site-header h4{font-family:var(--fdisp);line-height:1.08;margin:0;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;font-weight:800;font-size:17px}
.site-header :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--amber-l);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
.site-header .ico{width:1em;height:1em;flex:0 0 auto;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;vertical-align:-.125em}
.site-header [data-not-in-build]{cursor:not-allowed}
.site-header [data-not-in-build]::after{content:" \2197";opacity:.5;font-size:.85em}

/* The whole navigation is one sticky block. The negative offset is the
   height of the utility bar, so the bar scrolls away and the main bar pins
   to the top, which is how the original behaved. */
.site-header{
  position:sticky;top:calc((var(--utilh) + 1px) * -1);z-index:140;
  font-family:var(--fbody);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink);
}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gut);padding-right:var(--gut)}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--amber);color:#111;
  padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;z-index:200}
.skip:focus{left:12px;top:12px}
.logoimg{background:var(--logo) center/contain no-repeat;display:block}

/* buttons used in the mega panel footers and the drawer */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55em;font-family:var(--fdisp);
  font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;letter-spacing:-.01em;padding:14px 26px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;min-height:48px;
  text-align:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             background var(--t-fast) var(--ease),border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn svg{transition:transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn-amber{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--amber-l),var(--amber));color:#231704;
  box-shadow:0 0 26px -4px rgba(247,168,10,.60),0 0 46px -12px rgba(247,168,10,.45)}
.btn-amber:hover{box-shadow:0 0 36px -2px rgba(247,168,10,.80),0 0 60px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.50)}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--glass);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line2);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--glass2);border-color:rgba(247,168,10,.55)}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 18px;font-size:14px;min-height:40px}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ utility bar */
.utilbar{background:var(--utilbg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--utiltext);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.utilbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:22px;
  height:var(--utilh);flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.utilbar a{padding:8px 0;transition:color .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.utilbar a:hover{color:var(--amber-l)}
.utilbar .tel{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
@media(max-width:900px){.utilbar .util-hide{display:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .utilbar .wrap{justify-content:center}
  .utilbar a:not(.tel){display:none}
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- main bar */
.hdr{background:var(--hdrbg);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hdr .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
  min-height:92px;position:relative}

.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;padding:10px 18px;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);box-shadow:var(--e1);
  transition:border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}
.brand:hover{border-color:rgba(247,168,10,.45);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.55),var(--ring)}
.brand .logoimg{height:60px;width:auto;aspect-ratio:372/114}
@media(max-width:1180px){.brand .logoimg{height:48px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.brand .logoimg{height:38px}.brand{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:13px}}

.navcap{flex:0 1 auto;padding:5px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  border:1.5px solid transparent;
  background:
    linear-gradient(#0c0f1c,#0c0f1c) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(120deg,var(--amber),var(--blue) 55%,var(--amber)) border-box;
  box-shadow:0 0 30px -10px rgba(247,168,10,.50),0 0 18px -12px rgba(59,130,246,.50)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.nav > li{list-style:none;margin:0;position:static}
.nav ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
@media(max-width:1400px){.navlink{padding:9px 9px;font-size:14px}}
@media(max-width:1300px){.navlink{padding:9px 7px;font-size:13.6px}.navcap{padding:4px}}
@media(max-width:1180px){.navcap{border-color:transparent;background:none;box-shadow:none;padding:0}}

.navlink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 11px;
  font-family:var(--fdisp);font-weight:600;font-size:14.4px;color:var(--hdrtext);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);transition:background .15s,color .15s;background:none;
  border:0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.navlink .chev{transition:transform .2s}

/* ===== THE DROPDOWN FIX ============================================
   The mega panels used to be opened by JavaScript, which importers remove,
   so on the imported site nothing happened. They now open on :hover for
   pointer users and :focus-within for keyboard and touch users.
   =================================================================== */
.mega{
  position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 10px);left:50%;
  width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 48px));
  background:var(--menubg);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);
  box-shadow:var(--e4),0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  padding:26px;z-index:130;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px);
  transition:opacity var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             visibility 0s linear var(--t-fast);
}
.nav > li:hover > .mega,
.nav > li:focus-within > .mega{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  transition:opacity var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease),
             visibility 0s;
}
/* Invisible bridge across the gap between the trigger and the panel. Without
   it the pointer leaves the list item on the way down and the panel shuts
   under the cursor, which is what made the old menu feel broken. */
.mega::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:100%;height:46px}

.navlink:hover,
.nav > li:hover > .navlink,
.nav > li:focus-within > .navlink{background:var(--glass2);color:var(--ink)}
.nav > li:hover > .navlink .chev,
.nav > li:focus-within > .navlink .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}

.mega-wide{width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-mid{width:min(660px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-nar{width:min(600px,calc(100vw - 48px))}
.mega-nar > ul{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0 30px;align-content:start}
.mega-nar .mega-foot{justify-content:flex-end}

.mega h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber);
  margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:700}
